facts.text: The clone is a Thorlabs APT controller compatibility library for the BPC-303 controller through USB
The README gives the move argument in microns
The README lists piezo zeroing, control-mode changes and closed-loop piezo movement
Module.__init__ enables closed-loop mode and sends the zero-position message
Module.move clamps the requested travel between 0 and the configured max_travel
Module.move sends message 0x0646 with a 2-byte channel word and a 2-byte output position computed from 0 to 32767
Module.zero sends message 0x0658 with payload 0x01,0x00 to the module bay
Module.set_closed_loop sends message 0x0640 with 0x01,0x02 for closed loop and 0x01,0x01 for open loop
APT detects used bays among 10 and constructs each Module with a fixed max_travel constructor argument
The controller opens the FTDI device 0x0403:0xfaf0 at 115200 baud, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit and no parity
